name: bpmn-pilot
description: Draw and edit BPMN diagrams in the BPMN Pilot editor open in your browser.
long_description: Connects Claude to the online BPMN Pilot editor (https://bpmn.leylines.fr) open in a browser on this computer. Claude reads, draws, lays out, checks and exports the diagram with the same tools as the built-in AI co-pilot. Every change shows up live and can be undone with Ctrl+Z. The extension is a local relay: diagrams go from Claude to the browser tab on this computer, through no other server. In the editor, click "Connect an agent" and turn on the local agent.
